title: how I find energy to live everyday - my new expectations
en: The magic of autumn is already with us. The palette of the forest changed to golden larches and red blueberry leaves. I was recently reminded of a favorite quote by children's author Roald Dahl, and I feel like it embodies a lot of my feelings this fall. Look at the world around you with shining eyes, because the greatest secrets are always hidden in the most unexpected

places. He who does not believe in magic will never find it. And for me, autumn is the perfect time to rediscover this fairy-tale magic. Whether or not we have the energy to face each day with enthusiasm, we have the potential to travel through boundless inner worlds, learning about ourselves and others in the process. In the previous video, I

described myself as someone who doesn't have a lot of energy, and that's completely natural for me, I've accepted it. I will always naturally be the person who takes things slower and gets tired easily . And I think this applies to anyone who has ever felt overwhelmed or perhaps anxious because of the responsibilities of adult life and the high expectations they have for themselves. It is very important to celebrate every achievement, even the smallest one. It could be something small: time to choose a thoughtful outfit, cleaning, washing dishes, self-confidence, or, as in my

case, quality time baking and enjoying the fall atmosphere. Allowing myself some quality time, which often seems unattainable in the midst of a busy work schedule. There was a time in my life when sitting down and eating a full meal was probably the most difficult task for me. I'll tell this story in more detail someday, but the fact is that I would never have made any progress in healing my relationship with myself and food if I hadn't celebrated every tiny step and corrected myself gently when I fell short. I still find great

value in getting up every day and celebrating each successful step, instead of looking at the day as a whole, seeing it as many small opportunities for a good life. I don't usually bake in the evenings, but I decided to try it

and see what would come of it, completely immersing myself in the process: I lit a lot of candles, immersed myself in that autumn atmosphere—it was just wonderful and very meditative. Just in case, I know that every time I light candles, it makes some people nervous, but I promise that I am extremely careful with my candles and always very careful when I light them. But I genuinely enjoy this atmosphere, especially this time of year when it gets a little cooler, especially in the evenings and mornings. I really appreciate it. So I'll continue to experiment with apple pie or apple and peach pie, and we'll see what happens. OK. Lie down. Go lie down

. Actually, I don't have much experience in baking pies. Luke, my husband, is a really accomplished baker. He has a whole cookbook about it, and he has made quite a few very delicious pies. So I usually leave that matter to him. I was a little worried because last time the cake I made exploded. Luckily, this cake was a success and I ended up eating a good portion of it right out of the pan, and it was just delicious. There's a wonderful woman in our town who runs a cute little thrift store

, and I bought these little creamer and sugar sets from her, they're so cute. They cost about $2. So I'm just enjoying the moment to truly appreciate all these cute little things . And, of course, all these pumpkins, even my little pumpkin, which, to me, is just the cutest thing in the world. One of my favorite things about this time of year is that the grocery stores are filled with this gorgeous, colorful corn. And she is simply incredibly beautiful. I love decorating my house with it. And so many little things I enjoyed this week. I send you all my love. Thank you very, very much, and see you soon. See you later.
zh: 秋天的魔力已经与我们同在。森林的色调变成了金色的落叶松和红色的蓝莓叶。最近我想起了儿童作家罗尔德·达尔最喜欢的一句话，我觉得它体现了我今年秋天的很多感受。用闪亮的眼睛看周围的世界，因为最大的秘密总是隐藏在最意想不到的事情中
地方。不相信魔法的人永远找不到它。对我来说，秋天是重新发现这种童话魔法的最佳时机。无论我们是否有精力热情地面对每一天，我们都有潜力穿越无边的内心世界，在这个过程中了解自己和他人。在上一个视频中，我
将自己描述为一个没有太多精力的人，这对我来说是完全自然的，我已经接受了。我自然会是一个做事慢一点、容易疲倦的人。我认为这适用于任何因成年生活的责任和对自己的高期望而感到不知所措或焦虑的人。庆祝每一项成就非常重要，即使是最小的成就。可以是一些小事：选择一套体贴的衣服、清洁、洗碗、自信，或者，就像我的
案例，享受烘焙和享受秋季氛围的优质时光。给自己一些优质的时间，这在繁忙的工作日程中似乎是难以实现的。在我的一生中，有一段时间，坐下来吃一顿饱饭对我来说可能是最困难的任务。有一天我会更详细地讲述这个故事，但事实是，如果我没有庆祝每一个微小的步骤并在我失败时轻轻地纠正自己，我永远不会在治愈我与自己和食物的关系方面取得任何进展。我还是觉得很棒
重视每天起床并庆祝每一个成功的步骤，而不是把这一天视为一个整体，将其视为美好生活的许多小机会。我通常不在晚上烘烤，但我决定尝试一下
看看会发生什么，让自己完全沉浸在这个过程中：我点燃了很多蜡烛，让自己沉浸在秋天的气氛中——这真是太美妙了，非常冥想。以防万一，我知道每次点燃蜡烛都会让一些人紧张，但我保证我会非常小心地使用蜡烛，并且在点燃蜡烛时总是非常小心。但我真的很喜欢这种氛围，尤其是一年中的这个时候，天气变得有点凉爽，尤其是在晚上和早上。我真的很感激。所以我将继续尝试苹果派或苹果桃子派，看看会发生什么。好的。躺。去躺下
。事实上，我对烤馅饼没有太多经验。我的丈夫卢克是一位非常有成就的面包师。他有一整本关于它的食谱，而且他做了很多非常美味的馅饼。所以我一般都会把这件事留给他。我有点担心，因为上次我做的蛋糕爆炸了。幸运的是，这个蛋糕很成功，我最后直接从锅里吃了很大一部分，而且非常美味。我们镇上有一位很棒的女士，她经营着一家可爱的小旧货店

，我从她那里买了这些小奶精和糖套装，它们太可爱了。它们的成本约为 2 美元。所以我只是享受真正欣赏所有这些可爱的小东西的时刻。当然，所有这些南瓜，甚至是我的小南瓜，对我来说，它都是世界上最可爱的东西。每年这个时候我最喜欢的事情之一就是杂货店里摆满了这种华丽、色彩缤纷的玉米。她简直美得令人难以置信。我喜欢用它装饰我的房子。这周我喜欢很多小事情。我把我所有的爱都送给你。非常非常感谢，很快再见。稍后见。
